info.description:
The course provides
students with knowledge about grammar, pronunciation, language functions so
that they will be able to communicate and discuss in different topics: power
and responsibility, appearance, adulthood, healthcare, modern art, food, success, the invention, human and nature, children and teenagers’ psychology and acquire
language proficiency at level B2.
info.decisionNo: Ban hành theo QĐ CTĐT TDTU

clos.loDetails: Know some grammatical points, sentence patterns and some aspects of pronunciation used in topics related to daily life such as basic information about individuals and families, fashion trends, houses, behavior, family relationships, environment, personal stories, jobs, health, etc.
Understand some common functional languages in communication with language proficiency at level B2.
Analyze and synthesize formal and informal communicative situations
Build a short oral presentation and present it publicly
